name: Wand of Time always crits Undead and Demons (#10851)
contract: Wand of Time's tooltip says "This spell is guaranteed to critically strike against Undead and Demons". Its ranks (520165, 520175, 520702-520707, 524960) are DmgClass 3 (ranged) Chronomancer spells (SpellFamilyName 28, SpellFamilyFlags word1 0x100000, unique to Wand of Time) and nothing forced the crit, so they crit at the normal ranged chance. Expected: against an undead and a demon target the taken crit chance is 100, against a beast it stays at the normal chance, and other ranged-class spells are unaffected. An undead target that cannot be critically hit (SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACKER_SPELL_AND_WEAPON_CRIT_CHANCE at -100 or lower, here Blessed Resilience 33143) is not crit, as for Lava Burst and the Ascension guaranteed-crit auras.
